note: The forty guided experiments of D270 and what each needs of the model: reactions (ids of reactions.json), couples (ids of couples.json), network (species of the aqueous network whose equilibria carry the experiment), substances (ids of the substance catalogue it starts from), indicators (elements of supplement_indicators.dat), noReaction (why none is needed), gaps (what the model does not show). The list of the 26 curriculum experiments follows docs/research/2664/chemistry.md §2 and is to be checked against the curriculum standards before the guided experiments are written.

name.zh: 粗盐中难溶性杂质的去除
name.en: Removing insoluble impurities from crude salt

experiments.noReaction: Dissolving, filtering and evaporating: the solubility of Halite in the network, an inert solid for the sand; no declared reaction.

name.zh: 氧气的实验室制取与性质
二氧化碳的实验室制取与性质
name.en: Preparing carbon dioxide and its properties

experiments.noReaction: Marble with hydrochloric acid is the equilibrium of the network plus the dissolution kinetics of calcite chips (section dissolution of reactions.json); CO2 in water and in limewater is equilibrium.
experiments.gaps: That carbon dioxide puts out a candle is a matter of the flame model, not of a reaction.

name.zh: 常见金属的物理性质和化学性质
name.en: Physical and chemical properties of common metals
name.de: Physikalische und chemische Eigenschaften gebräuchlicher Metalle

name.en: Chemical properties of common acids and bases
name.de: Chemische Eigenschaften gebräuchlicher Säuren und Basen

experiments.gaps: Rust and copper oxide dissolve in acid by the network; powders dissolve at once, coarse lumps of these oxides have no dissolution rate.

name.zh: 一定溶质质量分数的氯化钠溶液的配制
name.en: Making a sodium chloride solution of a given mass fraction
name.de: Herstellen einer Natriumchloridlösung mit vorgegebenem Massenanteil

name.zh: 水的组成及变化的探究

experiments.gaps: Electrolysis is computed from the couples and the overpotentials of the section electrolysis.

The three conditions are needs.ignite, the ignition temperature Tign of the substance and the oxygen of the gas space. White phosphorus (the classic low ignition point) is not stocked: the comparison uses red phosphorus against charcoal, and ethanol against water on cotton wool.

name.zh: 配制一定物质的量浓度的溶液
name.en: Making a solution of a given amount concentration

experiments.noReaction: Weighing, dissolving, transferring and making up to the mark only.

name.en: Properties of iron and its compounds
name.de: Eigenschaften von Eisen und seinen Verbindungen

experiments.gaps: White Fe(OH)2 turning grey-green and red-brown in air is Fe2_O2 followed by the precipitation of Fe(OH)3 in the network; the green intermediate (green rust) has no species.

name.zh: 不同价态含硫物质的转化
name.en: Converting sulfur between its oxidation states
name.de: Umwandlung von Schwefel zwischen seinen Oxidationsstufen

experiments.gaps: Sulfite with acid giving SO2, and FeS with acid giving H2S, are equilibria of the network.

name.zh: 用化学沉淀法去除粗盐中的杂质离子
name.en: Removing impurity ions from crude salt by precipitation
name.de: Entfernen von Fremdionen aus Rohsalz durch Fällung

experiments.noReaction: Precipitation and neutralisation: equilibria of the network only.

name.zh: 同周期、同主族元素性质的递变
name.en: Trends across a period and down a group
name.de: Eigenschaftsänderungen innerhalb einer Periode und einer Gruppe

name.zh: 化学反应速率的影响因素
name.en: What changes the rate of a reaction

experiments.gaps: The effect of the surface (powder against lumps) comes from the forms of the solids; marble with acid from the dissolution table.
The cell itself is the electrochemistry of the engine (Nernst potentials of the couples, the circuit solver).

name.zh: 搭建球棍模型认识有机化合物分子结构的特点
name.en: Building ball-and-stick models of organic molecules

experiments.noReaction: Done in the three-dimensional viewer; no bench chemistry.

name.en: Main properties of ethanol and acetic acid
name.de: Wichtige Eigenschaften von Ethanol und Essigsäure

experiments.gaps: Active anode and deposition at the cathode: section electrolysis.
Gases stored on the graphite electrodes during electrolysis are then consumed by the two couples; adsorption on the electrode is not modelled.

name.zh: 探究影响化学平衡移动的因素
name.de: Einflüsse auf die Lage des chemischen Gleichgewichts

name.zh: 强酸与强碱的中和滴定
name.en: Titration of a strong acid with a strong base
name.de: Titration einer starken Säure mit einer starken Base

experiments.noReaction: Equilibrium of the network and the indicators.

name.en: Uses of the hydrolysis of salts

experiments.gaps: Colloidal iron(III) hydroxide from boiling water is computed as a precipitate; the colloid and its Tyndall effect have no model.

experiments.noReaction: Complex equilibria of the network only.
experiments.gaps: The blue precipitate of Fe2+ with hexacyanoferrate(III) is outside the network (its composition varies).

name.zh: 乙酸乙酯的制备与性质
name.en: Preparation and properties of ethyl acetate

name.zh: 有机化合物中常见官能团的检验

experiments.gaps: The violet colour of phenol with iron(III) chloride needs a species of the network that does not exist yet.
The blue of starch with iodine needs a species of the network that does not exist yet.

name.en: Copper with concentrated and dilute nitric acid
name.de: Kupfer mit konzentrierter und verdünnter Salpetersäure

experiments.gaps: Bleaching of a dyed cloth or of litmus by hypochlorous acid has no reaction (the dye is not a species).

experiments.noReaction: Emission lines of the elements (flames.json); no reaction.

name.zh: 电解水与电解饱和食盐水
name.en: Electrolysis of water and of saturated brine
name.de: Elektrolyse von Wasser und von gesättigter Kochsalzlösung

experiments.gaps: Discharge order from the section electrolysis; chlorine meeting the alkali of the cathode side gives hypochlorite by the network.

experiments.noReaction: Equilibrium of the network and its enthalpies.

name.zh: 滴定曲线（强酸强碱、弱酸强碱、多元酸）

experiments.noReaction: Equilibrium of the network and the indicators.
Solubility equilibria of the network only.

name.zh: 平衡的移动（NO₂/N₂O₄，Fe³⁺ 与 SCN⁻）

experiments.gaps: The sudden blue needs the starch–iodine species; without it the clock shows the brown of triiodide.
